presets.name: Minimal
presets.description: File Explorer and dark mode only. Easy to undo.

presets.name: Recommended
presets.description: A calmer everyday PC: Explorer, dark mode, fewer suggestions, less telemetry, and a small set of inbox apps removed.

presets.name: Gaming
presets.description: Game Mode on, background game recording off, raw mouse input, and no Sticky Keys prompt while playing.

presets.name: Privacy
presets.description: The safe privacy tweaks: less telemetry, no advertising ID, no activity history, and no web results or highlights in search.

tweaks.name: Show file extensions
tweaks.description: Always show extensions such as .pdf and .exe so a file's type is obvious.

tweaks.name: Show hidden files
tweaks.description: Show files Windows marks as hidden. Protected system files stay hidden.

tweaks.name: Open File Explorer to This PC
tweaks.description: New Explorer windows open on This PC. Undo opens Quick access, which is the usual default.

tweaks.name: Show protected system files
tweaks.description: Also show files Windows hides to protect the system. Leave this off unless you need it.

tweaks.name: Dark mode
tweaks.description: Use dark colors for Windows and for apps that follow the system theme. Undo returns both to light mode.

tweaks.name: Taskbar search as an icon
tweaks.description: Replace the wide search box with a search icon. Undo restores a search box.

tweaks.name: Hide the Widgets button
tweaks.description: Remove the Widgets button from the taskbar. The Widgets app is not uninstalled.

tweaks.name: Hide the Chat button
tweaks.description: Remove the taskbar Chat button. Teams itself is not uninstalled.

tweaks.name: Hide the Copilot button
tweaks.description: Remove the Copilot button from the taskbar when this version of Windows has one.

tweaks.name: End Task on the taskbar
tweaks.description: Add End Task to taskbar right-clicks so a frozen app can be closed without Task Manager.

tweaks.name: Turn off Start menu suggestions
tweaks.description: Stop the Start menu from recommending apps and tips.

tweaks.name: Turn off tips and suggested apps
tweaks.description: Reduce lock-screen tips, suggested apps, and other Windows promotional notices. Undo turns those notices back on.

tweaks.name: Turn off the advertising ID
tweaks.description: Stop apps from using the Windows advertising ID for this account.

tweaks.name: Reduce diagnostic data
tweaks.description: Ask Windows for the lowest diagnostic level this edition allows. Home and Pro often ignore a request for zero and keep required diagnostics. Undo removes the policy so Windows can use its own default.

tweaks.name: Turn off activity history
tweaks.description: Stop Windows from collecting and uploading activity history for this PC. Undo removes the policy.

tweaks.name: Turn off Bing in Windows Search
tweaks.description: Keep Windows Search on local apps and files instead of web results. Undo allows web results again.

tweaks.name: Disable the Connected User Experiences service
tweaks.description: Stop and disable the DiagTrack service, which sends diagnostic data. Undo sets it back to automatic. This is stronger than the diagnostic-data policy.

tweaks.name: Disable the compatibility appraiser task
tweaks.description: Disable a scheduled task that collects app compatibility data. Undo enables the task again.

tweaks.name: Classic File Explorer right-click menu
tweaks.description: Show the full Windows 10 style menu instead of the shorter Windows 11 menu. Undo deletes only the key WinTool adds.

tweaks.name: Turn off fast startup
tweaks.description: Shut down fully instead of using hybrid sleep. Boot can be a little slower. Helpful when dual-booting or when updates want a real shutdown.

tweaks.name: Turn off mouse acceleration
tweaks.description: Make the pointer travel the same distance for the same mouse movement. Sign out if it does not change right away. Undo restores the usual Windows acceleration.

tweaks.name: Remove suggested inbox apps
tweaks.description: Uninstall a short list of promotional and trial apps for the current user. The Microsoft Store, Calculator, Photos, Notepad, and Phone Link stay. Undo tries to put an app back only when Windows still has a provisioned copy.

tweaks.name: Remove extra inbox apps
tweaks.description: Also remove Sticky Notes, Camera, Mail and Calendar, alarms, and Xbox overlays for this user. Skip this if you use those apps. Restore works only while Windows still has the provisioned package.

tweaks.name: Show the full path in the title bar
tweaks.description: File Explorer windows show the whole folder path, not only the folder name. Undo shows only the name again.

tweaks.name: Compact File Explorer view
tweaks.description: Less space between items in File Explorer, like Windows 10. Undo returns to the roomier layout.

tweaks.name: Hide recent files and folders in Home
tweaks.description: File Explorer's Home stops listing recently used files and frequent folders. Undo shows them again.

tweaks.name: Open folders in a separate process
tweaks.description: Each File Explorer window runs on its own, so one stuck window does not freeze the taskbar. Uses a little more memory.

tweaks.name: Show This PC on the desktop
tweaks.description: Adds the This PC icon to the desktop. Undo removes it again.

tweaks.name: Hide Gallery in File Explorer
tweaks.description: Removes the Gallery entry from the File Explorer sidebar. Undo shows it again.

tweaks.name: Turn off the Snap layouts pop-up
tweaks.description: Hovering over the maximize button no longer opens Snap layouts. Win+Z and dragging to the edges still work.

tweaks.name: Align the taskbar to the left
tweaks.description: Moves the Start button and taskbar icons to the left, like Windows 10. Undo centers them again.

tweaks.name: Hide the Task View button
tweaks.description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar. Win+Tab still opens Task View.

tweaks.name: Show more pins in Start
tweaks.description: Start shows more pinned apps and fewer recommendations. Undo returns to the default layout.

tweaks.name: Hide recent files in Start
tweaks.description: Start and jump lists stop showing recently opened files. Undo shows them again.

tweaks.name: Stop tracking app launches
tweaks.description: Windows stops tracking which apps you open to fill Start and search. Undo turns tracking back on.

tweaks.name: Never combine taskbar buttons
tweaks.description: Each window gets its own taskbar button with a label. Undo combines them again.

tweaks.name: Show seconds in the taskbar clock
tweaks.description: Adds seconds to the clock. Uses slightly more power on laptops.

tweaks.name: Turn off transparency effects
tweaks.description: Menus and the taskbar use solid colors instead of see-through effects. Can feel snappier on older PCs.

tweaks.name: Accent color on title bars
tweaks.description: Window title bars and borders use your accent color. Undo returns to neutral title bars.

tweaks.name: Open menus faster
tweaks.description: Shortens the delay before submenus open from 400 ms to 200 ms. Applies after signing in again.

tweaks.name: Turn off minimize and maximize animations
tweaks.description: Windows snap open and closed without the zoom animation. Applies after signing in again.

tweaks.name: Turn off lock screen tips and ads
tweaks.description: The lock screen stops showing fun facts, tips, and promotions. Undo turns them back on.

tweaks.name: Turn off suggestions in Settings
tweaks.description: Settings stops recommending content and apps. Undo turns them back on.

tweaks.name: Stop "finish setting up" reminders
tweaks.description: Windows stops suggesting ways to finish setting up the device after updates. Undo turns the reminders back on.

tweaks.name: Turn off online speech recognition
tweaks.description: Voice typing and Cortana-style speech stay on the device instead of using Microsoft's cloud service.

tweaks.name: Turn off inking and typing personalization
tweaks.description: Windows stops building a personal dictionary from what you type and write. Undo turns it back on.

tweaks.name: Stop feedback requests
tweaks.description: Windows stops asking how it is doing. Undo lets Windows decide again.

tweaks.name: Hide your language list from websites
tweaks.description: Websites can no longer read your list of Windows languages to pick content. Undo allows it again.

tweaks.name: Turn off Recall snapshots
tweaks.description: Sets the policy that stops Recall from saving snapshots of your screen on Copilot+ PCs. Undo removes the policy.

tweaks.name: Turn off Windows Copilot (policy)
tweaks.description: Sets the user policy that turns off Windows Copilot. The Copilot app from the Store is not removed. Undo removes the policy.

tweaks.name: Block location access for apps
tweaks.description: Apps can no longer ask for your location. Maps and weather may need you to type a place. Undo allows apps to ask again.

tweaks.name: Turn off search highlights
tweaks.description: The search box stops showing daily highlights and trending content. Undo shows them again.

tweaks.name: Keep search on this PC
tweaks.description: Windows search stops including results from OneDrive, Outlook, and other Microsoft accounts. Undo includes them again.

tweaks.name: Turn on clipboard history
tweaks.description: Win+V shows the last things you copied. Undo turns history off.

tweaks.name: Allow long file paths
tweaks.description: Lets apps that support it use paths longer than 260 characters. Helpful for developers. Undo restores the old limit.

tweaks.name: Show detailed startup and shutdown messages
tweaks.description: Windows says what it is doing during sign-in, sign-out, and shutdown, instead of only "Please wait".

tweaks.name: Show details on the blue screen
tweaks.description: A crash screen shows the technical error parameters, which helps when searching for a fix. Undo removes the setting.

tweaks.name: Turn off Remote Assistance invitations
tweaks.description: Nobody can be invited to see and control this PC with Remote Assistance. Remote Desktop is not affected.

tweaks.name: Download updates only from Microsoft
tweaks.description: Windows Update stops sharing update pieces with other PCs on the internet or network. Undo removes the policy.

tweaks.name: Keep my default printer
tweaks.description: Windows stops changing the default printer to the last one you used. Undo lets Windows manage it again.

tweaks.name: Turn off Windows Error Reporting
tweaks.description: Crashes are no longer reported to Microsoft. You lose possible fixes Microsoft finds from reports.

tweaks.name: Disable the Customer Experience task
tweaks.description: Disables the scheduled task that sends Customer Experience Improvement data. Undo enables it again.

tweaks.name: Stop the Sticky Keys prompt
tweaks.description: Pressing Shift five times no longer asks to turn on Sticky Keys. Sticky Keys still works from Settings.

tweaks.name: Num Lock on at sign-in
tweaks.description: Num Lock is on when you sign in. Undo leaves it off.

tweaks.name: Turn off background game recording
tweaks.description: Stops Game Bar from recording gameplay in the background, which can cost performance. Undo turns it back on.

tweaks.name: Turn on Game Mode
tweaks.description: Windows prioritizes the game you are playing and holds back updates during play. On by default. Undo turns it off.

tweaks.name: Stop Edge running in the background
tweaks.description: Sets Edge policies so it does not preload at sign-in or keep running after you close it. Undo removes the policies.

tweaks.name: Skip Edge's first-run pages
tweaks.description: Edge opens without the welcome and import pages. Undo removes the policy.
